notes.title: Steam Deck Verification & Sale
notes.content:
[b]ONE BTN BOSSES is now VERIFIED and fully playable on the Steam Deck, to celebrate it the game is 20% off![/b]

Are you dreaming about beating bosses on the go? Dream no longer pilot for ONE BTN BOSSES should work tipy-topy without any configuration needed on the Steam Deck! Earn grind points on the train, plane or the toilet! Play with either the steam decks built in gamepad or with the touchscreen, whatever fits your on-the-go or in-the-bed situation better.

But if you don’t have any grind points yet and are eager to jump into THE OFFICE now that you can do that on the Steam Deck, look no further as I have 5 tips for you:

[olist]
[*] Keep moving fast, to shoot faster and stronger bullets! 
[*] Grinding a rank? Press R to restart quickly!
[*] If you need more GP to unlock something, just jump into a quick ROGUELIKE run!
[*] Try out different module combinations if you’re having issues with a boss!
[*] And if even that doesn’t work, just skip it – there are always other levels you can do!
[/olist]


Don’t own a steam deck but still want to switch to playing on the go? We’re cooking up some versions of the game that will be playable on multiple different devices that you can take on the

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[i]We’re trying to see if it’s possible for us to get the game onto some other platforms right now. Until then this is a small patch addressing some quality of life problems and improving the experience on the deck.[/i]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] You should now be able to set the game into windowed (fullscreen) mode
[*] You can now quick restart the game with R (Triangle/Y on controller)
[*] Instead of seeing “Action Button” in the game’s text the icon of your bound button should now dynamically appear
[/list]

Thanks for playing pilots!

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Tidying Up
notes.content:
Hello all, welcome to the first patch notes! We did some minor balancing and addressed the most drastic bugs. It’s likely some things you guys want are not addressed here, we are reading your feedback and understanding where it’s coming from. New QOL features, such as seeing highscores from within the level select screen, windowed mode or a quick restart button.

We’re taking a few weeks off from working on the game directly to let the initial steam sales settle before we commit to anything. However what we can commit to is a set of small competitions we will be hosting in the [url=https://discord.gg/emnQQWebuM]discord[/url]. Starting next week we will be hosting a string of competitions for 3 weeks straight and we’re excited to see you all completely break the game. 

[b]Due to balancing changes the highscores have been cleaned up! The 1.0.0 archive can be found here:[/b]
[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR\_ISw4I7HZr3X8Di4i9HW1JLtO2LaiEZjJsOanzOdJGjYhCsR8xtw6lpjPdDGNAfYDo02B6\_LQudlW/pubhtml][u]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_ISw4I7HZr3X8Di4i9HW1JLtO2LaiEZjJsOanzOdJGjYhCsR8xtw6lpjPdDGNAfYDo02B6_LQudlW/pubhtml[/u][/url]
[h1]Quality of Life[/h1][list][*]Reverse now includes a visual, 0 - 100, indicator of how much of a charge you have completed[/*][/list][h1]Module Balancing[/h1]
All changes here are effective in both the campaign and rifts.
[list][*][b]Laser[/b]  [/*][*]
Damage at high spark levels has been reduced by about 10%
[/*][*]
[b]Dash[/b]  
[list][*]Fixed a bug where it would take a couple of frames for the immunity to trigger. It should now feel more responsive for those of you that did notice.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]Rifts[/h1][list][*]Floor 4 and 5 fights, both HR and Elites, have had their difficulty slightly increased  [/*][*]Squares that travel the arena’s path should now appear in smaller numbers  [/*][*]The HP of shielding assistants that can appear as a level modifier has been decreased by 33%  [list][*]Additionally, they each subsequently spawned assistant will appear slightly later  [/*][/list][/*][*]Floor bosses now get really angry if you fight them for an incomprehensibly high amount of time (they despise any attempts of pacifism)  [/*][*]It is no longer possible to lose HP on shops while at 1HP. You will only be offered common, free powerups instead.[/*][/list][h2]Discoveries in Rifts[/h2][list][*][b]Laser[/b]  [list][*]Effectiveness of All Or Nothing has been halved  [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Juggler[/b]  [list][*]Several bugs related to Two Hands Only have been fixed which reduce jugglers potential maximum DPS  [/*][/list][/*][*][b]General[/b]  [list][*]Fragments of Aidoxe are now slightly more common  [/*][*]Pacifist should be slightly rarer[/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][list][*]The levels around Star’s cluster should now be clickable on more resolutions, sorry click clique  [/*][*]Several typos have been fixed, we’re very soryr about that  [/*][*]It is no longer possible to skip the boss changing shape animation. [/*][/list][h2]Rifts[/h2][list][*][b](Shooter)[/b] 999 bullets text that incorrectly stated that the count resets when hit has been removed.  [/*][*][b](Juggler)[/b] Fixed card interactions that made it so you can have more than 2 Primary Jugglers while playing with Two Hands Only  [/*][*][b](Reload)[/b] It is now impossible to fire low charge bullets impossibly fast by spamming buttons on two different input devices.  [/*][*][b](All modules)[/b] Attack Zone affecting discoveries should now behave correctly[/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck & ONE BTN BOSSES
notes.content:
Hello pilots!

The game is coming out in 2 days and we wanted to inform you about the Steam Deck functionality. While we personally don’t have access to a Steam Deck we have tested the game out on Linux with comparable hardware. But more importantly, we have heard from friends and press that have access to the game (and have Steam Decks) that the game is functioning perfectly.

So for Steam Deck owners, we’re excited to say that you will be able to enjoy one button bullet hell action on the go!

If you find some bugs specific to the deck we strongly encourage you to report them on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1910600/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url] or on the [url=https://discord.gg/emnQQWebuM]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: DEMO Update - 2024/06/13
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996681/81eb6056578dd3a53bd4af26fdeb9ed31cbbe881.gif[/img]

What's up, pilots!
We are back with another round of bug-fixes. Thank you for the reports!

In the small update 1.0.3, we are addressing some UI bugs. They shouldn't have had a big impact on you or the game, but better get them out of the way as soon as we can!

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where changing music volume settings wouldn't persist from the main menu to the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where leaving the pause menu in the overworld with the mouse didn't work and left a strange game state.
[*] Fixed a bug where tabbing out of the game wouldn't show you your correct time in the overworld.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would let you scroll through the world with the mouse.
[/list]

Remember that we currently have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1910600/announcements/detail/4150709804573447193]time competition[/url] going on where the winners will get the chance to have their name featured in the game. And competition is [b]fierce![/b]

This is all! Enjoy the rest of the Next Fest!

notes.title: Best Time Competition - Get Your Name In ONE BTN BOSSES Full Game!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey gamers!! We hope you're enjoying the Demo of ONE BTN BOSSES! We have a little competition for you - the prize?[/h1]

[h3]How do you participate?
[/h3]

1 - play the last level of the Demo (The Future)

[b]You have time until the end of Steam Next Fest[/b] ([url=https://www.timeanddate.com/countdown/to?iso=20240617T19&p0=736&msg=ONE+BTN+BOSSES+DEMO+COMPETITION&font=slab]June 17th at 7pm CET[/url]).

notes.title: Steam Next Fest DEMO is LIVE!
notes.content:
Dear pilots,

we’re very excited to tell you that the demo is now playable and a part of Steam Next Fest! Dive into it now and experience a few handcrafted levels and a taste of the roguelike game mode ahead of release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996681/29f228aa1d7bf96571c9c10e5578809db86651a4.gif[/img]
What else is new besides the demo being up?

We will be holding a competition! For all of you god-gamer pilots out there, keep an eye out on our [url=https://discord.gg/cTFF5JrsNg]Discord server[/url]! We will be holding a competition there in a few days and the ones that will be a part of it will get their names featured in the game’s story.

[b]We got a publisher![/b] As just revealed at [url=https://www.summergamefest.com/]Summer Games Fest[/url] we’re a part of [url=https://www.innersloth.com/outersloth/]Outersloth[/url] funding scheme, meaning that our game is backed by the minds behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/945360/Among_Us/]Amogus[/url]!

[b]Are you in Madrid and love competing?[/b] Come swing by [url=https://www.madgamesshow.com/]Mad Games Show[/url], where you will be able to compete on our patented whiteboard leaderboards on June 14th and 15th!

[b]We’re releasing SOON![/b]This is our last demo before the game releases. And while we can’t say the exact date we can tell you that it’s going to be very very soon.

[b]Excited?[/b] Join us in the [url=https://discord.gg/cTFF5JrsNg]Discord server[/url], share your epic builds from the roguelike game mode, discuss the starts to get to the top of the leaderboards!

notes.title: ONE BTN BOSSES Demo releases on June 7th!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Pilots, we have a fresh demo of ONE BTN BOSSES! 
[/h1]

It's been a while since the last time you were able to get your hands on the game, and as we're getting [i]closer and closer[/i] to the full release of the game, we thought we'd make a new demo for you to check out how it's looking right now :) 

[b]The demo will release on June 7th, at around 11 p.m. CEST. [/b]

It will include part of the 4-hour campaign (including a couple of the bosses) [b]AND[/b] the first floor of the randomly generated roguelike mode!!! [u]We're so excited for you to play it, and we can't wait to know what you think <3 [/u]

Oh and if you're craving for a community to talk about 1BB with, you can click [url=https://discord.gg/bCFJU2Kvkw]here[/url] to [b]join our brand new Discord server[/b], where we post news before everywhere else, secret updates, and much more. 

Talk soon!

notes.title: Going Rogue Demo Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41996681/27062fe45bdcbef55414da7a43ed6a4c0156e098.png[/img]

One Btn Bosses is a part of Going Rouge! To celebrate the try-die-try-again nature of the game we decided to participate in Steam's Going Rogue festival and let you all try out a taste of what is to come. So grab the demo and dive headfirst into [b]5 different bosses[/b], try out [b]3 different module combinations[/b] and hone your skills ahead of the full release!
